candidates.description: This feature vector activates on terms related to robotics, automation, and mechanical engineering.
This vector represents concepts related to robots, automation, and project engineering.
German modal and auxiliary verbs expressing necessity, possibility, and past or future tense.
This vector represents common German suffixes, root words related to work and time, and isolated morphological components.
This vector represents common German adverbial and prepositional elements or modifiers frequently used in compound structures.
This feature activates on morphological fragments and root components of words related to automation, vehicles, and specific proper nouns.
This vector represents subword tokens related to biological and optical terms, particularly prefixes and roots involving "bio-" (life) and "photo-" (light).
This vector represents computer software, programming, and computational tools.
This feature vector activates strongly on the letter sequence "aut" (case-insensitive) appearing at the beginning or within various words and proper nouns.
This vector activates on German prepositional and verbal prefixes starting with 'au' and 'aus'.
